automations.title: Automations
automations.subtitle: Turn on pack recipes. There is no canvas yet — pick a starter, set delays and templates, then test.
automations.createHint: Industry packs ship these recipes. You choose one, then edit delays, channels and templates. A visual builder is later.
automations.created: Recipe added. It stays off until you turn it on.
automations.needTemplate: Approve a template for these channels first.
automations.onlyIfNoReply: Only run if they have not replied
automations.blocked: This recipe cannot use a channel the contact has not agreed to.

empty.title: No recipes yet
empty.body: Add a recipe from your industry pack, then turn it on when the channel is connected.

marketing.title: Marketing

emptyPlanner.title: No posts this week
emptyPlanner.body: AI drafts from your brand and reviews will land here to approve and schedule.

emptyCampaigns.title: No campaigns yet
emptyCampaigns.body: Create a broadcast, run the pre-send check, then send once the template is approved.

emptyTemplates.title: No templates
emptyTemplates.body: Start from a pack template, then submit WhatsApp copy for review.

emptyLinks.title: No tracked links
emptyLinks.body: Create a click-to-WhatsApp or booking link and print a poster.

emptyForms.title: No forms yet
emptyForms.body: Build an intake form, publish it, then share the hosted link.

emptyResponses.title: No responses yet
emptyResponses.body: Submissions appear here after someone fills the public form.

marketing.created: Campaign created — check who can receive it before you send.
marketing.emailFooter: Email templates always include your business name and an unsubscribe link to the preference center.
marketing.needTemplate: Approve a template for this channel first.
marketing.createHint: Pick who should get it, a channel, and an approved template. We’ll check consent before anything is sent.
marketing.groupHint: Only people in this group. New matches are included next send.
marketing.name: Campaign name
marketing.blocked: Cannot send yet — see who was excluded and why
marketing.label: Poster label
marketing.originsHint: One origin per line, for example https://www.your-salon.com. Leave empty while you test on localhost.
marketing.scriptHint: Paste one script tag on your site. Inline puts the form in the page; popup opens it from a button. Breaking changes ship as a new path so this snippet keeps working.
marketing.scriptConsent: The popup shows the same form as the hosted page, including the consent checkbox. The visitor ticks that — it is not recorded just because the script loaded.
marketing.sourceHint: UTM parameters, referrer and landing page are stored on the contact with every submit. Add ?src=instagram to the hosted link for that placement.

reputation.title: Reputation
reputation.rewardBlocked: Wording that offers a reward is not allowed.
reputation.alerts: A 1–2 star review needs a reply today.
reputation.reconnectGbp: Google Business Profile needs a reconnect before new reviews sync.
reputation.exclusions: Opted-out contacts are skipped. Requests are never filtered by how the visit went, and wording cannot offer a reward.

payments.title: Payments
payments.neverHold: Deskhand never holds funds. The customer pays through your gateway.
payments.missing: Connect Paystack or Flutterwave in Connections.
